metadata.usage: Used by Pramaan Engine to verify accident reporting compliance, insurance notification timelines, and Claims Tribunal jurisdiction for challan/claim disputes.

sections.title: Report of Accident to Claims Tribunal
sections.content_summary: Mandates the forwarding of accident reports to the Claims Tribunal and insurer within specific timelines.

rules.actor: Officer in Charge of Police Station
rules.action: Forward copy of accident report/information recording
rules.trigger: Recording of information OR completion of report under Section 159
rules.pramaan_flag: If police report not forwarded within 30 days, flag as 'Procedural Violation - Section 160'.

rules.trigger: Receipt of copy of report from police
rules.condition: Where a copy is made available to the owner
rules.pramaan_flag: If owner fails to forward report within 30 days of receipt, flag as 'Non-compliance - Section 160'.

sections.title: Information regarding Accidents (Context for 160)
sections.content_summary: Requires police to record information regarding accidents involving injury or damage. This section triggers the reporting obligation in Section 160.

rules.action: Record information or complete report regarding accident
rules.details: Must include details of vehicle, driver, injured persons, and nature of accident.
rules.pramaan_flag: Verify if FIR/ACC report exists. If challan issued without accident report where injury occurred, flag as 'Missing Documentation'.

claimstribunalprocedures.jurisdiction: Claims Tribunal having jurisdiction over the area where accident occurred.

document_flow.note: Can be filed based on the police report forwarded under Section 160.

pramaanintegrationnotes.usage: This JSON serves as the 'Official Rule' source for the Pramaan Engine when auditing Traffic Challans related to accidents or verifying insurance claim eligibility timelines.

matching_strategy.reportingtimelinecheck: Match 'Date of Accident' vs 'Date of Report Forwarding' against Section 160 (30 days). Flag delays.
matching_strategy.insurancenotificationcheck: Verify if 'Insurer' was notified within 30 days per Section 160. If challan/claim disputed due to late notice, check if police complied.
matching_strategy.ownercompliancecheck: If owner received report, verify forwarding to Tribunal within 30 days.
matching_strategy.jurisdiction_check: Ensure Claims Tribunal mentioned matches the accident location jurisdiction.
